meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: with lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation Off, "Publish" is not offered
gaps: Verify that lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off for the company.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off for the company.

steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the Drafts tab where the saved eRFX draft should be listed.
Open the first saved draft and land on its create screen.
Assert that the Publish control is not offered on the saved draft.
